<section class="home-intro ruled-section">
  <p class="section-index">01 / About the group</p>
  <div class="editorial-grid">
    <h2>Bayesian ideas, shared across a national community.</h2>
    <div class="prose-large">
      <p>The Bayesian Working Group is part of the <a href="https://www.seio.es/">Spanish Society of Statistics, Operations Research and Data Science (SEIO)</a>. It was founded at the 36th SEIO Congress in Toledo in 2016 as a point of reference for the Bayesian community in Spain.</p>
      <p>Our role is practical: to make connections between researchers, create opportunities for scientific exchange, support early-career colleagues and give Bayesian work greater visibility.</p>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="what-we-do ruled-section">
  <p class="section-index">02 / What we do</p>
  <div class="principles">
    <article>
      <span class="principle-number">A</span>
      <h3>Convene</h3>
      <p>We organise workshops and sessions where new Bayesian research can be presented and discussed.</p>
    </article>
    <article>
      <span class="principle-number">B</span>
      <h3>Connect</h3>
      <p>We link Bayesian researchers across universities, research centres and fields of application.</p>
    </article>
    <article>
      <span class="principle-number">C</span>
      <h3>Support</h3>
      <p>We create space for early-career researchers and help circulate relevant opportunities and resources.</p>
    </article>
  </div>
</section>
